title: Self-Build Building Warrant & Completion (Scotland)
description: Scottish building warrant and staged inspection workflow for a self-build dwelling. Requires a Planning Permission Verifiable Credential as a prerequisite. Features structural calculations, Building Standards review against 7 Scottish standards, staged site inspections, and issuance of Building Warrant and Completion Certificate credentials.
author: Sorcha Team

template.title: Self-Build Building Warrant & Completion (Scotland)
template.description: Scottish building warrant process for a self-build house. Runs on the Building Standards Register and requires a Planning Permission Verifiable Credential issued from the Planning Register. Features structural calculations submission, 7-standard Building Standards review, staged inspections (foundation, structure, completion), and issuance of Building Warrant and Completion Certificate credentials.

metadata.features: Multi-Register, Credential Requirement, Staged Inspections, Calculations, Rejection, Verifiable Credential

participants.name: Self-Builder
participants.description: Applicant presenting Planning Permission VC and submitting building warrant application with technical drawings and specifications.

participants.name: Lead Engineer
participants.description: Submits structural calculations package, foundation design, and wind/snow loading analysis.

participants.name: Building Standards Officer
participants.description: Reviews application against the 7 Scottish Building Standards, calculates warrant fee, and issues Building Warrant.

participants.name: Building Inspector
participants.description: Conducts staged site inspections (foundations, structure & weathertight, final completion) and issues Completion Certificate.

actions.title: Submit Building Warrant Application
actions.description: Self-builder submits building warrant application with approved planning drawings, building specifications, and energy performance calculations. Must present a valid Planning Permission Verifiable Credential from the Planning Register.

credentialRequirements.description: Valid planning permission is required before a building warrant can be applied for

dataSchemas.x-introduction: Building warrant application. You must already hold a Planning Permission credential — the reference comes from that VC. Three pages: prerequisite, build specification, and attached drawings.

x-pages.title: Planning prerequisite
x-pages.description: Evidence of planning permission and the start date.

x-pages.title: Build specification
x-pages.description: Construction method, thermal envelope and cost.

routes.description: Route to structural engineer for calculations

actions.title: Structural Calculations Submission
actions.description: Structural engineer submits structural calculations package including foundation design, wind and snow loading analysis, and Eurocode compliance confirmation. Calculates a structural adequacy score.

actions.title: Building Standards Review
actions.description: Building Standards Officer reviews the application against the 7 Scottish Building Standards: Structure, Fire, Environment, Safety, Noise, Energy, and Sustainability. Calculates the building warrant fee based on estimated build cost.

dataSchemas.x-introduction: Assess the application against the seven Scottish Building Standards, record an overall decision, and attach the technical report. Single-page review so you can see all seven standards together.

x-sections.title: Seven Scottish Building Standards
x-sections.description: Mark each standard pass, fail or minor-amendment.

routes.description: All 7 standards satisfied — issue building warrant

actions.title: Issue Building Warrant
actions.description: Building Standards Officer formally issues the building warrant. A Building Warrant Verifiable Credential is minted and issued to the self-builder, which is required for staged inspections.

routes.description: Warrant issued — construction begins, first inspection at foundations stage

actions.title: Foundation Inspection
actions.description: Building Inspector conducts on-site inspection of foundations before backfill. Verifies depth, concrete specification, reinforcement, damp-proof membrane, and drainage runs. Requires presentation of the Building Warrant credential.

credentialRequirements.description: Valid building warrant required for staged inspections

routes.description: Foundations acceptable — proceed to structure inspection

actions.title: Structure & Weathertight Inspection
actions.description: Building Inspector verifies structural frame completion, roof, windows/doors, insulation specification, and air-tightness test results. Calculates energy performance classification based on air-tightness result.

routes.description: Structure and weathertight acceptable — proceed to final inspection

actions.title: Final Inspection & Completion Certificate
actions.description: Building Inspector conducts final inspection verifying all services connected, fire safety, electrical and plumbing certifications, and energy performance. Issues a Completion Certificate Verifiable Credential — legally required before the dwelling can be occupied.

dataSchemas.x-introduction: Final inspection before issuing the Completion Certificate. Three pages: on-site sign-off, compliance evidence, and photographic/certificate attachments.

x-pages.title: Site inspection
x-pages.description: What the inspector saw on the day.
